about.title: About Us
about.description: Inversiones Tunki Chasky S.R.L. is a leading intercity passenger transport and parcel logistics company in the Cusco region. Operating modern 4 and 6-passenger vehicles, we deliver Formal, Safe, Reliable, and Punctual services for all travelers.

1.title: Machu Picchu Route
1.desc: Direct and fast connection for tourists and locals seeking punctuality to Hidroeléctrica.

2.title: La Convención Route
2.desc: Daily trips via the Málaga pass with experienced mountain drivers.

3.title: Quellouno Route
3.desc: Safe and quick transport connection to the Quellouno tropical valley every day.

4.title: Sacred Valley Route
4.desc: Frequent transport to the heart of Calca in modern vehicles.

5.title: Train Connection
5.desc: Arrive on time for your train to Machu Picchu with our executive service.

6.title: National Route
6.desc: Special service to the capital city with GPS and 24/7 active tracking.

7.title: Interurban Route
7.desc: The fastest and safest travel choice connecting Cusco to Abancay.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.sec1Title: Ticket Purchase and General Service Conditions
terms.sec1Item1: Passengers must provide valid identification and, if applicable, Tax ID (RUC) and company name. NO CORRECTIONS, CANCELLATIONS OR REFUNDS are accepted once the payment receipt is issued.
terms.sec1Item2: It is the passenger's responsibility to verify the information on the ticket upon receipt. Acceptance of the ticket constitutes full agreement with these terms. NO REFUNDS ALLOWED.
terms.sec1Item3: Fares are referential and subject to change according to seasonal demand without prior notice.
terms.sec1Item4: Tickets are personal and non-transferable, valid strictly for the route, date, and time specified.
terms.sec1Item5: Passengers are entitled to transport up to 25 kg of personal luggage (max 40x40x30 cm). Excess luggage is subject to vehicle capacity and applicable rates.
terms.sec1Item6: Tickets with erasures, alterations, or damage will not be accepted for travel or rescheduling.
terms.sec1Item7: No modifications, rescheduling, or refunds are permitted for tickets purchased within 59 minutes of scheduled departure.
terms.sec1Item8: For safety and security reasons, 200 PEN banknotes are not accepted.
terms.sec1Item9: Counterfeit banknotes will be retained and reported to competent authorities.
terms.sec1Item10: Exchange of sales receipts for tax invoices after purchase is not permitted.
terms.sec1Item11: Passengers are solely responsible for their personal belongings. The company is not liable for undeclared items or improperly packed luggage.
terms.sec1Item12: All passengers are covered by mandatory road accident insurance (SOAT).
terms.sec1Item13: Convalescent passengers must travel accompanied by a healthcare professional under their own responsibility.
terms.sec1Item14: In case of road contingencies preventing normal transit, the company is authorized to arrange passenger transfers.
terms.sec1Item15: Diaper changing and the consumption of hot prepared food inside the vehicle cabin is prohibited.
terms.sec1Item16: Transport of gas cylinders, fireworks, or hazardous combustible materials is strictly prohibited.
terms.sec2Item1: In accordance with Law No. 27337, minors traveling without their parents must present certified notarized travel authorization. Children under 9 years old may not travel unaccompanied.
terms.sec2Item2: Children over 5 years old must have their own full ticket and assigned seat.
terms.sec3Item1: Passengers must arrive at the boarding point 30 minutes prior to departure. Failure to do so results in ticket forfeiture without refund.
terms.sec3Item2: Passengers and minors must present their valid original ID document and physical/electronic ticket to board.
terms.sec3Item3: Boarding is prohibited for persons under the influence of alcohol or unauthorized substances.
terms.sec3Item4: Carrying firearms, bladed weapons, explosives, or toxic substances is strictly prohibited.
terms.sec3Item5: Pets are not allowed in the passenger cabin, except certified service animals with valid health certificates.
terms.sec3Item6: Boarding or disembarking at unauthorized stops is strictly prohibited.
terms.sec3Item7: Disembarkation at intermediate points requires advance request and driver authorization based on road safety.
terms.sec4Item1: Rescheduling requests must be made in person at least two (02) hours before the scheduled departure time.
terms.sec4Item2: Passengers may request Open-Date status for up to 30 calendar days from the original travel date.
terms.sec4Item3: In case of suspension due to force majeure, trips will be rescheduled within 12 hours of service resumption.
terms.sec5Item1: Reservations are valid temporarily and will be automatically canceled if payment is not confirmed.
terms.sec5Item2: Users must complete their payment via authorized channels to secure their seat.
terms.sec6Item1: Senders must present valid ID and accurately declare parcel contents and packaging.
terms.sec6Item2: Parcels will only be released to the designated recipient upon presentation of original ID.
terms.sec6Item3: No claims will be accepted once the parcel has been inspected and collected from our office.
